name: PandaX Collaboration
notes: This record documents only the PandaX-4T phase of the PandaX programme; earlier phases (PandaX-I, PandaX-II) are out of scope for this wave and have no experiment: record here.

No membership roster file is written (institution: ids belong to a different workstream); no institution/country/member count is recorded because pandax.sjtu.edu.cn names partner institutions but does not state an aggregate scientist/institution/country count in the content fetched.

summary.plain: The team of scientists, led from Shanghai Jiao Tong University, that built and runs the PandaX-4T dark matter detector in China.
summary.technical: PandaX Collaboration, PandaX-4T phase: led by Shanghai Jiao Tong University's Laboratory of Particle Physics and Cosmology, with partners including the Tsung-Dao Lee Institute, Institute of High Energy Physics and Center for Astronomy & Astrophysics.
